findings.current: And the Southern Heaven Demon Empress’s attacks, which should have left her vomiting blood and collapsing to her knees long ago, were no longer as heavy as before.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the implied target of the attacks, saying the Southern Heaven Demon Empress’s own attacks should have left her vomiting blood and kneeling.
findings.rationale: 남천마후의 공격 identifies her as the attacker; the one who should have been made to vomit blood and kneel is her opponent.
findings.replacement: And the Southern Heaven Demon Empress’s attacks—which should long ago have left the Beast Miao King vomiting blood and collapsing to his knees—were no longer as heavy as before.
findings.source: 진즉 피를 토하며 무릎을 꿇고도 남았을 남천마후의 공격은 전처럼 무겁지 않았다.

findings.current: A small fist that should have struck her chest and burst her heart had made the bones in her hand shift out of place.
findings.defect: The draft again reverses the target, making her fist supposed to strike her own chest and burst her own heart.
findings.rationale: The fist belongs to the Southern Heaven Demon Empress and was intended to crush the Beast Miao King’s chest and heart.
findings.replacement: The bones shifted out of place in the small fist that should have smashed into his chest and burst his heart.
findings.source: 가슴을 후려치고 심장을 터트려야 했을 작은 주먹에서 뼈가 어긋나는 소리가 새어 나온다.

findings.current:
The Southern Heaven Demon Empress retched.

Blood leaked through her clenched teeth.
findings.defect: 울컥 describes blood surging or welling up here, not the Southern Heaven Demon Empress retching.
findings.rationale: The following sentence explicitly identifies the substance rising and escaping between her teeth as blood; no gagging or retching action is stated.
findings.replacement: A surge of blood welled up and leaked through her clenched teeth.
findings.source:
울컥.

악문 잇새 사이로 핏물이 흘러나온다.

findings.current:
Footsteps approached, treading over ground soaked in blood, sand, and ruins.

No—footsteps.
findings.defect: The draft uses the plural both before and after the correction, erasing the deliberate realization that one approaching footfall is actually many.
findings.rationale: 발걸음. 아니, 발걸음들 explicitly shifts from singular to plural, revealing that a group is approaching.
findings.replacement:
A footfall approached over blood-soaked ground, treading on sand and rubble.

No—footfalls.
findings.source: 핏물을 머금은 땅을. 모래와 잔해를 밟으며 다가오는 발걸음. 아니, 발걸음들.

findings.current: Toward her loyal subordinate, whose neck hung limply after something had torn it away, and who was waiting for a recovery that surpassed even supernatural powers.
findings.defect: The wording says his neck was torn away entirely while simultaneously hanging limply, making the injury mechanically incoherent.
findings.rationale: The Masked Man still has a connected but catastrophically torn neck; 뜯겨 나간 describes the flesh being ripped away, not the entire neck being detached.
findings.replacement: Toward her loyal subordinate, whose neck hung limply, already torn open by something, and who was awaiting a recovery that surpassed even supernatural powers.
findings.source: 이미 무언가에 의해 뜯겨 나간 목줄기를 축 늘어트린 채. 괴력난신(怪力亂神)이라는 단어로도 부족할 회복을 기다리는 자신의 충실한 수하를 향해.

findings.current: more than a dozen spears flew over Jin Taekyung’s head.
findings.defect: The draft changes 십여, approximately ten or a dozen, into a quantity definitively greater than twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 means roughly ten-plus rather than specifically more than a dozen.
findings.replacement: a dozen or so spears flew over Jin Taekyung’s head.
findings.source: 진태경의 머리 위로 십여 자루의 돌격창이 날아왔다.

findings.current: No matter how much of a Ten King the Beast Miao King was, and no matter how much he had been underestimated because he was a Nanman tribesman, he had clearly been a level below her.
findings.defect: “No matter how much of a Ten King” is unidiomatic and treats membership in the Ten Kings as a degree rather than a fixed status.
findings.rationale: 십왕의 한 사람 means one member of the Ten Kings; the concessive force comes from 제아무리, not from degrees of membership.
findings.replacement: Even though the Beast Miao King was one of the Ten Kings, and even if he had been relatively underestimated because he was from Nanman, he was clearly a level below her.
findings.source: 야수묘왕이 제아무리 십왕의 한 사람이라 해도, 남만인이기에 비교적 과소평가를 받았다 해도 그녀보다는 명백하게 한 수 아래였으니까.

findings.current:
As though they had agreed on it from the beginning, they surged forward as one streak of wind.

They would not grant her even a momentary opening, let alone time to leave final words.

They had only one resolve: to cut off the breath of the Fiend known as the Southern Heaven Demon Empress.
findings.defect: The draft turns the narrator’s inferred impression into a categorical statement of the attackers’ intent, dropping the 듯이 pragmatic qualification.
findings.rationale: 주지 않겠다는 듯이 means they moved as if determined to give her no opening or time for final words; the source presents that intent as an impression conveyed by their charge.
findings.replacement:
As though they had agreed from the start, they became a single streak of wind and surged forward—as if to deny her even the briefest opening, let alone time for final words.

They had only one resolve: to cut off the breath of the Fiend known as the Southern Heaven Demon Empress.
findings.source:
마치 처음부터 약속이라도 한 것처럼, 그들은 한 줄기의 바람이 되어 쇄도했다.

더 이상 찰나의 틈도, 유언을 남길 시간도 주지 않겠다는 듯이. 남천마후라는 악귀(惡鬼)의 숨통을 끊어 놓겠다는 일념 하나만으로.

summary: Several actionable fidelity errors alter attack subjects, injury mechanics, quantity, and pragmatic modality; the draft also loses a deliberate singular-to-plural reveal.
